units: Analysis package initializer defines/exports analysis functionality.
Report module converts supplied analysis dictionaries into Markdown-style summaries/recommendations.
Report generation consumes already-computed analysis values; it does not itself execute experiments or establish their provenance.
Analysis statistical module provides paired-comparison/effect-size style utilities over supplied numeric samples.
evaluate_reca_hypothesis accepts records/features and returns sample count, feature labels and the stated RECA hypothesis description.
The function exposes a hypothesis-evaluation interface but does not itself define a fitted causal/predictive model, coefficient criterion or full uncertainty decision rule.
Trajectory analysis computes moving-average/slope-style summaries from supplied sequences.
Module estimates pre/post/recovery trajectory characteristics around perturbation points.
Implemented viability-expansion heuristic uses change in viability multiplied by one minus a volatility term.
The heuristic's scale/range and relation to theoretical G_V are not established inside the implementation.
Metrics package initializer defines imports/exports for recursive-depth, consequence-coupling, consolidation, viability, composite and statistical metric surfaces.
Recursive-depth module classifies adaptive events by the structural depth/type of change represented in event data.
Module aggregates event-level depths into summary statistics for an adaptive trajectory.
Depth estimation depends on event structures/categories supplied to the metric rather than independently discovering mechanism identity from arbitrary system state.
Correctness of event labels as evidence of true mechanism-level recursive depth is external to this metric module.
Consequence-coupling module estimates association/coupling between supplied consequence values and adaptive-change features/events.
Module includes a shuffled-consequence sanity check intended to compare observed coupling against broken temporal/correspondence structure.
Estimator consumes supplied consequence/change-feature records rather than directly intervening on the agent/environment causal process.
Association plus shuffle control does not by itself identify causal consequence authority or exclude common causes/selection effects.
Adaptive-consolidation module estimates retention/persistence of adaptive structural information across time/events.
Consolidation score uses supplied event/history information to quantify how much adaptive structure remains represented later.
Retention alone does not establish that retained structure is useful, causal, or beneficial for future viability.
Composite module defines RECAResult-like structure for D_c, C_e, A_c and composite values.
Composite RECA metric combines supplied recursive-depth, consequence-coupling and adaptive-consolidation estimates into a product-style score.
Multiplication assumes compatible scaling and interaction semantics that are not established by the composite function itself.
Viability module defines viability-estimate/result structures and helper functions for current/future adaptive trajectory summaries.
Implemented viability helpers use supplied reward/performance/perturbation trajectory values to derive heuristic viability estimates.
Viability calculation is a proxy computation over observed trajectories, not a direct observation of all future adaptive possibilities.
Relation between implemented viability proxies and theoretical G_V/future adaptive capacity requires empirical construct validation.
Metric statistical module computes correlation-style relationships between supplied metric/outcome arrays and labels relationship strength by fixed cutoffs.
Implemented labels classify raw correlation magnitude/direction for convenience.
The fixed correlation labels do not supply the full uncertainty/effect-size/p-value/multiple-seed inference doctrine described in benchmark documentation.

Pytest source imports metric functions and contains deterministic assertions over representative recursive-depth, consequence-coupling, consolidation/composite/viability or helper behavior available in the current metric surface.
Test source encodes small unit-level expectations for metric-function outputs; it is not a benchmark-level scientific test of RECA.
The source file contains assertions but no persisted pytest report or CI execution record establishes that they ran/passed at the frozen head.
